phrases.catches: an old form said to keep working beside the current one: "still works", "is still read", "is also still accepted"
a form labelled deprecated: accepted today and refused some day, which is the state the product does not have
a form labelled legacy: older than the current one and accepted beside it
a form kept so that older input goes on working
a form said to exist only so that older input is accepted
a reader that tries the old form when the current one is absent
an old name kept as an alias of the current one
a change scheduled for a release that has not shipped: "in the next release", "a future version", "the next major"
a transition described from inside one release: "in this release", "until this release", "one release ahead", "warn-then-arm"
a promised change to the product: "will be removed", "will be renamed", "will be flipped"
a default described as about to change: "the default flips", "the default will become"
a feature announced before it exists

phrases.pattern: \bfor now\b|\bfor the time being\b|\bin the interim\b|\btemporarily\b
phrases.catches: current behaviour labelled as a temporary state: "for now", "for the time being", "in the interim", "temporarily"
a missing capability described as on its way: "not yet implemented", "not yet supported"

exemptions.reason: the word names something in the user's own project, not a spelling of this product: a Keep a Changelog category, and a marker the integration gate tells the reviewer to search the change for
exemptions.removeWhen: either gate's guidance stops naming the word

exemptions.reason: the page is a roadmap and issue log, forward-looking by purpose; its open item on inline gate definitions quotes the migration plan it was resolved by
exemptions.removeWhen: docs/TODO.md is deleted or its content moves under plans/
